asked.item: Add a link sticker to an IG Story through the API

verdict.reason: The Story link stickers section says the API doesn't support link stickers and gives a manual workaround.

steps.text: Instagram's API does not yet support adding link stickers (clickable URLs) to Stories published via third-party tools.
Publish the Story through Blotato as normal, then open the Instagram app and add the link sticker manually to the published Story.
